e-sljedivost.summary: A public portal for the Croatian government where anyone can scan a product's QR code, or type its ID, and follow the food back through the supply chain.
points: Built React and Material UI interfaces for tracking and analytics, with d3.js charts for producers, inspectors and the public.
Connected the UI to the Hyperledger Fabric network through Node.js endpoints that keep the screens in sync with the ledger.
Wrote chaincode in Go for the records the portal reads.

cross-chain-interop.summary: Atomic cross-chain supply, borrow and flash-loan flows on Puffer UniFi: one intention, signed once, executed on L1 and L2 with EIP-7702.
points: Redesigned the whole app to the new Puffer brand without a dedicated designer.
Built a shared UI kit and flow components while keeping every transaction flow's logic byte-identical.
Replaced the library toast rendering with an app-level provider so status messages read clearly in each step.

ai-assistant.summary: An AI assistant for the Puffer protocol: LLM tool calling over live and on-chain data, RAG pipelines and layered prompt-injection defences, red-teamed.
points: Built the server end to end in Node.js and TypeScript: 31 tools for live protocol and on-chain data, RAG on PostgreSQL and pgvector, streaming answers, provider fallback and a semantic cache.
Protected it with layered prompt-injection defences (input guards, cleaned tool results, output filtering) and red-teamed it with promptfoo and garak.
Built the chat in the Puffer app and the Telegram integration, plus the AI tooling around it: 3DBrain, a shared knowledge graph, and a coding-agent workflow with custom skills and guardrails.

reneverse.summary: Smart Ads, an in-game advertising and product placement platform. I built the backend and on-chain side; the website shown is the company's.
points: Built GraphQL APIs, microservices and data pipelines that process campaign and placement data.
Designed event-driven serverless workloads on AWS: Lambda, ECS, SQS, SNS, S3, RDS and DynamoDB.
Wrote and deployed Solidity contracts for on-chain ad verification and campaign tracking.

cryptotoday.summary: A community platform where crypto projects get listed by community vote instead of paid placement. I built the backend in 2024.
points: Built the REST APIs and PostgreSQL schema for listings, voting logic, deposits and rewards.
Ran the AWS infrastructure on ECS, RDS and Lambda.
Automated data aggregation with scheduled jobs and materialized views.

puffer-app.summary: Puffer's main liquid restaking app: stake ETH, receive pufETH, and manage vaults, DeFi positions and withdrawals.
points: Built frontend features across the staking, vault and withdrawal flows in React, wagmi and viem.
Integrated wallet connections and smart contract interactions for real user deposits.
Worked on the backend-for-frontend API that connects the app to on-chain data.

playgrnd.summary: A Croatian platform for amateur football: fixtures, live results, competitions, player profiles and stats.
points: Build frontend features across schedules, competitions and player pages.
Work on backend integrations behind them.
Contribute to the platform's AI features.

amo-na-canj.summary: A two-day summer sports festival by the Cetina river. I co-organised it and built the platform behind it.
points: Team registrations, live draws and brackets for five sports across age categories.
A real-time schedule and results with Supabase Realtime, plus a match-day admin panel.
A TV mode for the screens at the venue.

puffer-fi.summary: The rebranded puffer.fi marketing site, prerendered for speed and SEO.
points: Built the new site from scratch to staging in six weeks: React 19, React Router static generation, Vite and GSAP.
Set up its quality gates: 120+ unit, end-to-end, accessibility and SEO tests, Lighthouse audits and bundle budgets.
Moved routes, SEO and analytics over from the old site.

nk-osk-otok.summary: The full digital home of a Croatian football club, fed by the federation's live data.
points: Team, player and match pages for seven squads, with a season archive of 2,300+ matches back to 2005/06.
An automated pipeline from the federation's COMET API: standings, fixtures, line-ups, match events and player stats.
A Payload CMS admin built for non-technical club staff, with 240+ tests behind it.

this-portfolio.summary: This site: a scroll-driven walk-out into a 3D stadium inspired by Poljud, with every word prerendered for search and for visitors without WebGL.
points: Built the stadium in three.js from code: bowl, shell roofs, an instanced crowd animated on the GPU, players and bloom.
React Router static generation with per-page SEO, and the 3D scene in its own lazy chunk.
Tested with Vitest, Playwright and axe, with bundle budgets on every build.
